column1: Governing Base Plate & Anchor Rod Design Parameters (AISC Design Guide 1 & AISC 360-22 Sec. J8):

1. Anchor Rod Nominal Tensile Strength (AISC Table J3.2): F_nt = 0.75 * F_u; phi*R_n = 0.75 * (0.75 * F_u) * A_b = 0.5625 * F_u * A_b (LRFD); R_n/Omega = (0.75 * F_u * A_b) / 2.00 = 0.375 * F_u * A_b (ASD).

2. Anchor Rod Nominal Shear Strength (AISC Table J3.2): F_nv = 0.45 * F_u (threads included, N) or 0.563 * F_u (threads excluded, X). Per AISC DG1, if grout thickness > 0 or oversized base plate holes are used without welded plate washers, shear bending in the anchor rod must be checked (or transfer shear via shear lug / embedded column / friction).
3. Concrete Bearing Strength under Base Plate (AISC 360-22 Sec. J8 Eq. J8-2): P_p = 0.85 * f'_c * A_1 * sqrt(A_2 / A_1) <= 1.7 * f'_c * A_1, where phi_c = 0.65 (LRFD) and Omega_c = 2.31 (ASD).

4. Base Plate Cantilever Bending Yielding (AISC DG1): t_p,req = l * sqrt( (2 * P_u) / (0.90 * F_y * B * N) ) [LRFD] or l * sqrt( (3.33 * P_a) / (F_y * B * N) ) [ASD], where l = max(m, n, lambda * n').

5. OSHA Steel Erection Mandate (29 CFR 1926.755): All columns (except post-type columns weighing < 300 lbs) shall be anchored by a minimum of four (4) anchor rods/bolts, and the column/base plate assembly shall resist a minimum eccentric gravity load of 300 lbs located 18 in. from the extreme outer face of the column in each direction.
